tool_args.rationale: The pilot indicates both sink-gradient dependence and coupled transient memory. An additional trajectory batch can separate these effects and provide enough observations to fit and test a coupled model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a coupled siphon-memory model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not adequately identify the coupled transient and sink-gradient effects or distinguish competing mechanisms.
The pilot signatures also indicate a coupled transient lag, so a purely static fit could miss the horizon dependence.
It is not relevant to identifying the proposed mechanism.
